meta.title: Bengaluru aadhaar address update evidence ledger v1
meta.disclaimer: Independent research, not official advice. Public sources and known gaps are shown together; do not submit personal data through this ledger.

scenarios.label: Online address update using proof of address

scenarios.label: Online address update using a family member's Aadhaar
scenarios.summary: The same public page displays a separate family-member Aadhaar route, but it was not progressed beyond the public choice surface.

sources.title: myAadhaar Update Address public route
sources.notes: Direct public-interface observation of a 200 route. It displayed the document and family-member choices, ₹75 fee, 'Up to 30 days', supporting-documents button, status button, registered-mobile eligibility FAQ, and Talk To Aadhaar support. No visible page-version or last-updated date. A Wayback save request made on the access date did not return a stable snapshot URL; no substitute page was used.

sources.title: Aadhaar resident OTP login boundary
sources.notes: Direct public-interface observation of a 200 sign-in page reached from the document route. It displayed 'Login to Aadhaar via OTP', Aadhaar-number and CAPTCHA fields, and a 'Login With OTP' button. No visible publication date, last-updated date, or version date was observed; the ©2024 footer is not treated as a source date. This limits dating the login-page content. Limitation: no archive snapshot was taken because it is an authentication-bound surface; no login or fields were used.

claims.text: UIDAI's current Updating Data on Aadhaar page says the online mode lets an Aadhaar number holder directly place an address-update request on the myAadhaar portal.
claims.notes: This is document-based address update, not document refresh or HoF address borrowing.

claims.text: UIDAI says a mobile number registered with Aadhaar is required for the online address-update service.
claims.notes: Published access condition; no personal session was entered.

claims.text: UIDAI says the Aadhaar number holder uses the Aadhaar number to log in to the myAadhaar portal for the online address-update service.
claims.notes: Login boundary was not entered in this pass.

claims.text: UIDAI says the Aadhaar number holder is authenticated using an OTP sent to the registered mobile number for the online address-update service.
claims.notes: Authentication boundary was not entered in this pass.

claims.text: UIDAI says completing the online address-update process requires upload of a supporting proof-of-address document.
claims.notes: No document was selected or uploaded.

claims.text: UIDAI's List IV for Aadhaar update labels a proof-of-address document as containing the person's name and address in India.
claims.notes: List IV includes separate HoF/PoR material that is deliberately not used for this own-PoA primary scenario.

claims.text: UIDAI's List IV says a document submitted for Aadhaar update must be currently valid.
claims.notes: Applies to the submitted update document.

claims.text: UIDAI's List IV says a proof-of-address document submitted for Aadhaar update must be issued in the name of the individual seeking update.
claims.notes: This separates the own-PoA primary scenario from a HoF address-borrowing route.

claims.text: UIDAI's List IV says information in a document submitted for Aadhaar update must be verifiable from its source.
claims.notes: Applies to the submitted update document.

claims.text: UIDAI says the uploaded supporting proof-of-address document is verified against the requested data at a later stage by a quality and processing team.
claims.notes: This identifies the published operational role, not a named officer or a case decision.

claims.text: UIDAI's Online Address Update FAQ says a successful online address-update submission generates an SRN that is shown on screen and sent by SMS to the registered mobile number.
claims.notes: No SRN was generated or looked up.

claims.text: UIDAI's Online Address Update FAQ says that after successful submission the person should download an invoice containing the SRN and other details.
claims.notes: The retained source does not state an amount for this service.

claims.text: UIDAI's Online Address Update FAQ says update-request status can be checked by logging in to Check Aadhaar Update Status.
claims.notes: The status route was not entered because it is login/case-data bound.

claims.text: UIDAI's Online Address Update FAQ says an address-update request can be rejected when the proof-of-address document is not valid under the supporting-document list.
claims.notes: Documents the encountered rejection branch, not an individual rejection.

claims.text: UIDAI's Online Address Update FAQ says an address-update request can be rejected when the proof-of-address document is not in the Aadhaar holder's name.
claims.notes: Documents the encountered rejection branch, not an individual rejection.

claims.text: UIDAI's Online Address Update FAQ says an address-update request can be rejected when the address entered does not match the address in the proof-of-address document.
claims.notes: Documents the encountered rejection branch, not an individual rejection.

claims.text: UIDAI's Online Address Update FAQ says an address-update request can be rejected when the uploaded image is not a clear coloured scan of the original proof-of-address document.
claims.notes: Documents the encountered rejection branch, not an individual rejection.

claims.text: The public Update Address route offered 'Using your document' and instructed the visitor to provide a recent proof of address with their name and new address.
claims.jurisdiction: India; nationally administered service, including Bengaluru residents

claims.text: The public Update Address route also offered 'Using your family member’s Aadhaar' and described it as using a family member’s Aadhaar with the new address.
claims.jurisdiction: India; nationally administered service, including Bengaluru residents

claims.text: The public Update Address route displayed a ₹75 fee.
The public Update Address route displayed 'Up to 30 days'.
claims.jurisdiction: India; nationally administered service, including Bengaluru residents

claims.text: The public Update Address FAQ stated that an Aadhaar number holder having a registered mobile number in Aadhaar may use the service.
claims.jurisdiction: India; nationally administered service, including Bengaluru residents

claims.text: Selecting Start for the public document route navigated to the resident login URL on tathya.uidai.gov.in.
claims.jurisdiction: India; nationally administered service, including Bengaluru residents
claims.notes: This observation establishes only the public-to-login handoff. No login was used. No authenticated action, case data, upload, payment, submission, acknowledgement, status result, or rejection handling was observed.

claims.text: The destination page displayed a field labelled 'Enter Aadhaar Number'.
claims.jurisdiction: India; nationally administered service, including Bengaluru residents
claims.notes: The same page also displayed an 'Enter Captcha' field and a 'Login With OTP' button. Observation stopped before any field was used. This is the boundary between the public procedure and authenticated case data; upload, payment, submission, status results, and rejection handling remain unknown in this pass.

claims.text: One citizen reported that an online Aadhaar address update completed after the entered address wording was aligned with the wording in that person's rental agreement.
claims.notes: One August 2020 account. It does not establish that this wording practice is required, that a rental agreement is currently accepted, or that an online request will complete within the reported time.

claims.text: One citizen reported that an online Aadhaar address-update request was rejected with a data-mismatch message after documents were submitted.
claims.notes: One August 2020 account. The participant's thought about abbreviated address wording is not verified and is retained separately only as a possible lead.

claims.text: The citizen who reported a data-mismatch rejection speculated that differences between abbreviated and expanded address wording might have contributed.
claims.notes: An uncorroborated participant speculation, retained only as a checkable failure-mode lead; it is not a UIDAI requirement or diagnosis.

claims.text: One citizen reported that an address update appeared the day after that person uploaded a document through the Aadhaar portal.
claims.notes: One June 2026 account. It does not establish current processing time, document acceptance, portal behavior, or an official procedure.

claims.text: One citizen reported an online Head of Family address-update request rejected with a relationship/gender-mismatch reason.
claims.notes: One November 2023 household account. It establishes only that reported route and reported result, not the current Head of Family procedure or a general rejection rule.

claims.text: UIDAI's current public My Aadhaar page displays a ₹75 fee for Address update.
claims.notes: This corroborates claim_ind70_fee_display. The page names own documents as an address-update method; the existing public route supplies primary-scenario context.

claims.text: UIDAI's charge sheet includes address within the demographic-update service at an Aadhaar centre.
claims.notes: Centre comparison only; it does not change the primary scenario from online own-PoA address update.

claims.text: UIDAI's charge sheet states that a demographic update done separately at an Aadhaar centre costs ₹75.
claims.notes: Centre comparison only; the primary scenario remains the online own-PoA route.

claims.text: UIDAI's charge sheet states that the demographic-update component is free when done with a biometric update at an Aadhaar centre.
claims.notes: Conditional centre schedule only; this is not a zero fee for the primary online scenario.

claims.text: UIDAI's charge sheet lists Document update separately from demographic update.
claims.notes: Document update supports details already enrolled; its online waiver must not be applied to an address-change request.

claims.text: UIDAI's charge sheet states that Document update through myAadhaar is free until 14 June 2027.
claims.notes: Non-applicable comparison retained only to prevent conflation with the primary address-change scenario.

nodes.label: Access the document-based online route
nodes.summary: The own-PoA address-update route is account-bound through myAadhaar.
nodes.requiredState: Holder has Aadhaar and a registered mobile number for OTP authentication.

checks.label: Registered mobile and OTP
checks.description: A registered mobile number and OTP authentication are published prerequisites for online access.

nodes.label: Prepare own proof of address
nodes.summary: Use an applicable own-name proof-of-address document from UIDAI's update list.
nodes.requiredState: PoA is current, belongs to the person seeking update, is verifiable, and contains the necessary name and Indian address.

checks.label: List IV PoA conditions
checks.description: List IV defines PoA and its document acceptability conditions for update.

failureSignals.label: Invalid-document conditions
failureSignals.description: The FAQ lists invalidity, holder-name, address-match, and scan-quality grounds for rejection.

recoveries.label: Correct PoA evidence
recoveries.description: Use the current supporting-document list and ensure the entered address matches the own-name PoA before an authorised upload.

nodes.label: Later UIDAI quality and processing review
nodes.summary: UIDAI states that a quality and processing team later verifies the uploaded PoA against the requested data.
nodes.requiredState: Supporting PoA has been uploaded in an authorised request; no case result is known here.

checks.label: Published later verification
checks.description: UIDAI identifies later verification by a quality and processing team.

nodes.label: Use SRN, invoice, and status route after submission
nodes.summary: Published post-submission surfaces are an SRN, invoice, and login-bound status check.
nodes.requiredState: A successful authorised submission has occurred; this pass did not create or query one.

checks.label: SRN after successful submission
checks.description: Successful submission produces an on-screen and SMS SRN.

failureSignals.label: Published rejection grounds
failureSignals.description: Invalid-document conditions can result in rejection.

recoveries.label: Login-bound status check
recoveries.description: UIDAI directs the holder to log in to Check Aadhaar Update Status.

nodes.label: Public Update Address route
nodes.summary: Public choice surface for document or family-member address update.
nodes.requiredState: The visitor can view the public myAadhaar Update Address route.

checks.label: Document option visible
checks.description: The route states that the document option uses a recent proof of address with the visitor's name and new address.

recoveries.label: Public support surface
recoveries.description: The page displayed a Talk To Aadhaar support control.

nodes.label: OTP login boundary
nodes.summary: The public document route ends at a resident OTP sign-in page before case data can be viewed or submitted.
nodes.requiredState: An Aadhaar number holder has a registered mobile number, as stated in the public FAQ.

checks.label: OTP sign-in page visible
checks.description: The destination displays Login to Aadhaar via OTP and does not expose authenticated update steps publicly.

edges.label: The online address-update route requires supporting PoA upload.
Uploaded supporting PoA is later verified against requested data.

roadblocks.title: Proof-of-address document does not satisfy published conditions
roadblocks.symptom: The online address-update request is rejected for invalid documents.
roadblocks.likelyCause: UIDAI lists invalidity, name mismatch, address mismatch, or unclear/non-coloured original scan as published grounds.
roadblocks.recovery: Use a current, own-name, verifiable PoA from UIDAI's list and make the entered address match it before an authorised upload.

roadblocks.title: Authenticated procedure is not public
roadblocks.symptom: The document route leaves the public page and presents Aadhaar-number, CAPTCHA, and OTP sign-in controls.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The route requires resident authentication before it reveals case-specific update activity.
roadblocks.recovery: This public-workflow pass does not proceed through the sign-in boundary; use the official route with the required registered mobile number.

journeys.title: Published online Aadhaar address update with own proof of address
journeys.context: Published UIDAI route only; account, payment, upload, submission, and status-result boundaries remain unobserved.

steps.label: Meet online-access prerequisites
steps.action: Use the official myAadhaar route only if the Aadhaar mobile is registered; authenticate only in an authorised personal session.
steps.expectedResult: The holder can enter the account-bound address-update route.

steps.label: Prepare own PoA
steps.action: Select an applicable List IV own-name PoA document and ensure its address matches the intended address.
steps.expectedResult: A publishedly acceptable PoA candidate is ready for authorised upload.

steps.label: Retain published post-submission references
steps.action: After an authorised successful submission, retain the SRN and invoice, then use the official login-bound status route.
steps.expectedResult: The published acknowledgement and tracking surfaces are available without asserting a case outcome.

steps.label: Await later quality and processing review
steps.action: Treat the later verification as case-specific; do not infer approval from public guidance.
steps.expectedResult: UIDAI's published quality and processing review boundary is understood.

dependencies.description: Supporting PoA upload precedes UIDAI's published later verification against requested data.

recoveryNotes: Do not confuse this own-document address-change route with UIDAI's separate document-refresh or HoF-based update materials.
No case status should be inferred from public guidance; status requires the official login-bound route.
documentationQualityNotes: The retained online-address FAQ pages had no visible date when accessed on 2026-09-05, so their currentness is limited to that access date; the current update page displayed a 2026-07-03 last-updated date.
The public myAadhaar Update Address route was observed on 2026-09-04 and displayed a ₹75 fee and 'Up to 30 days'; authenticated upload, payment, submission, and result surfaces were not observed.

journeys.title: Public portion of online address update using proof of address
journeys.context: Unauthenticated inspection only; no Aadhaar number, CAPTCHA, OTP, upload, payment, submission, or case lookup was performed.

steps.label: Open Update Address
steps.action: Open the public myAadhaar Update Address route and select the document option's Start control.
steps.expectedResult: The public page describes a recent proof of address with the visitor's name and new address, then sends Start to the resident login route.

steps.label: Stop at OTP sign-in
steps.action: Observe the destination without entering any information.
steps.expectedResult: The public procedure stops at the Aadhaar-number, CAPTCHA, and OTP login screen; later case-specific steps are unknown.

dependencies.description: The observed public document Start action directs the visitor into resident OTP sign-in.

recoveryNotes: The public route displayed Talk To Aadhaar support, but this pass did not open it.
The page displayed Check Address Update Status, but this pass did not perform any SRN/URN or case-data lookup.
documentationQualityNotes: Two UIDAI FAQ/category seeds supplied for this pass returned HTTP 404 on 2026-09-04 and were dropped rather than replaced with a homepage.
The current public route supplies fee, timing, document-route description, and an OTP boundary, but not the authenticated upload, payment, submission, status-result, or rejection flow.
